title: Single-origin flight — tasting notes
body: Nutty body, low acidity. Ananya preferred the washed lot over the natural. Order two bags for next month's cupping.

title: Espresso dial-down on the rotary machine
body: Grind coarser by 0.4 after 3pm — the machine runs hot near the window and shots go sour.

title: Idea: quiet-hour study sessions
body: Low-fi weekday evening slot, no machine noise. Check whether it hurts the dinner rush before trialling it.

title: Stock take — milk and pastries
body: Four cartons of oat milk left against a par of ten. Meera counts pastries at close, so the reorder goes in first thing tomorrow.

title: Card settlements land Tuesday
body: Weekend card takings only settle on Tuesday, so keep enough float for refunds until then. UPI is the safer counter option on a Saturday.

title: Prep for the tasting — two grinders
body: Grind the washed Kenyan and the natural Brazil ahead of time. Ananya is bringing a colleague, so set the long table by the window.

title: Opening bar routine
body: Whoever opens runs the grinder purge before the first flat white — last night's setting pulls sour shots for the first hour.

title: Sheesham lot 42 — moisture reading
body: Kiln-dried to 11%. Two planks with casehardening; keep them for small parts rather than the dining top.

title: Kulkarni dining — finish choice
body: Client chose matte hardwax oil over PU for the table top. Delivery crew needs an extra 24h cure before install.

title: Meeting — workshop capacity
body: Can take two more bespoke orders for the month if the wardrobe job slips a week. Follow up with the vendor on ply delivery.

title: Wardrobe invoice — balance at delivery
body: Bill raised for the Priya Homes wardrobe with the balance due on delivery. They asked for the GST breakup in the same PDF.

title: Shah delivery — lift and hallway
body: Tower B service lift needs booking 24h ahead, and the sofa only goes in flat-packed — the hallway turns at 90cm.

title: Walkthrough shortlist — charcoal Luna
body: Priya liked the Luna sofa in charcoal and asked about a six-seater Oslo. Send the finish samples before the walkthrough.

title: Idea: offcut side tables
body: The teak offcuts from the last two orders would make a small run of side tables. Price them against the scrap we already hold before offering them.
